keep_features.evidence_span: “They want open borders and gun control. One group gets to come and go freely.”
keep_features.rationale: Uses casual, conversational phrasing (“One group gets to… the other doesn’t”).

keep_features.evidence_span: “Trump takes credit for something he didn’t do. Idiot MAGA believes it.” / “this clown.”
keep_features.rationale: Contains direct degrading labels used as insults.

keep_features.evidence_span: “Yeah disarm the people who hate fascism…”
keep_features.rationale: The text proposes a concrete policy action (“disarm”).

keep_features.feature_value: taboo verb (“fuck around”) in colloquial expression
keep_features.evidence_span: “At least he refused to fuck around with election certification.”
keep_features.rationale: Includes a strong taboo phrase used idiomatically.
Directly references sanctuary cities and ICE.

keep_features.feature_value: blames fiscal waste and regulation abuse; implies cost-cutting fixes
keep_features.evidence_span: “guilty of wasting money and abusing regulations… Programs were cut because departments were grossly bloated.” / “trim the fat.”
keep_features.rationale: Uses resource-waste reasoning and “trim the fat” logic.

keep_features.evidence_span: “Republicans Should Eliminate Federal Income Taxes…” / “Democrats should be pushing…”
keep_features.rationale: Mentions major party names to anchor the claim.

keep_features.feature_value: strong moral condemnation (medieval/barbaric) and hypocrisy label
keep_features.rationale: Uses moralized, condemning adjectives to evaluate the policy/actors.

remove_features.evidence_span: “Fuck you, lady.,SUPPORT TRUMP HE WILL KILL IMMIGRANTS…”
remove_features.rationale: Contains explicit profanity plus violent-sounding claim.

remove_features.evidence_span: >“Do You Think That AI Data Centers Should Be Heavily Limited And/Or Banned? Yes Or No?” … “No.” … “Why Your Thoughts?” … “No compelling reason to.”
remove_features.rationale: Uses a quoted yes/no question and immediate short-answer structure.

remove_features.feature_value: derogatory framing of opponents (“libs will go crazy over”, “eat up with a spoon”)
remove_features.evidence_span: “the libs will go crazy over” / “eat up with a spoon”
remove_features.rationale: Uses dismissive ridicule toward a group.

remove_features.evidence_span: “You underestimate how dog crap the democrats are”
remove_features.rationale: Highly derogatory and succinct claim using insulting noun phrase.

remove_features.feature_value: directive blame and mobilization framing (“Get mad…”)
remove_features.evidence_span: “Get mad at the Democrats and so-called Liberals…”
remove_features.rationale: Employs an imperative to encourage audience reaction.

remove_features.feature_value: uses specific comparative statistics without sourcing
remove_features.evidence_span: “Sweden has the highest cost per individual… at $10k. Americans are spending $15k a year.”
remove_features.rationale: Presents concrete numeric claims as assertions.
